transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Um... well. I guess I haven't been doing very well lately. 

I didn't really want to come in, but... what actually scared me enough to make the appointment is that I just keep thinking it would be easier if I didn’t wake up. And, um... sometimes when I’m driving home from the clinic, I... I catch myself wondering what would happen if I just didn’t turn the wheel. 

So... I figured I should probably talk to someone.
How long have you been having these thoughts about not wanting to wake up or wondering what would happen if you didn't turn the wheel while driving?
Um... maybe about a month? We... we recently had to take in a relative, and... it's just been this intense, up-and-down crisis since then. So... yeah. About a month.
Have you been enjoying things you usually like to do over the past month?

Not really, no. 

Um... I haven't even touched my camera. And I usually check the bird feeders, or... see what's coming up in the garden, but I just haven't had any real interest. 

It's... I don't know, it's actually kind of frightening, I guess. Just because... those things used to be how I felt like myself. But now... I just don't care.
Have you noticed any change in your weight over the past month?

Um... I guess so. I haven't really weighed myself, but... my appetite's just been weird. 

Some days it's all over the place, but... mostly I just pick at some toast in the morning. Or just have coffee. And then... I'll get to the end of a shift at the clinic and realize I haven't really eaten anything else all day. So... maybe I've lost some weight. I don't know.
Have you noticed any change in your energy level or how quickly you move compared to before this past month?

Yeah... I guess so. I'm just... really tired. 

Even at the clinic, just walking from the treatment area to the lab benches... it feels like I'm dragging myself through mud. And... by the time I get home, I can barely make dinner. Or help with the evening care routine. I just... don't have the energy.
Do you feel like you're moving more slowly than usual or having trouble sitting still?
Um... no, I don't think so. I haven't really paid attention to how fast I'm moving. And... I don't have trouble sitting still. I just haven't really noticed anything like that.
Have you been feeling guilty about anything lately?

Um... I suppose so. I just... things are chaotic at home right now, and... I get frustrated. 

Then I feel awful about it. I mean, I shouldn't resent the disruption, but I do. And... I keep replaying every time I've been short with them, or... given an impatient look. It just makes me feel like a terrible person. Sometimes I think... maybe they'd all just be better off without me around to make things worse.
Have you had any days in the past month where you felt somewhat better, or has it been constantly difficult?
No... not really. It's just... it's been the same. Every day.
Have you felt like you're moving slower than you usually do?
Um... I think you just asked me that a minute ago. But... no. Like I said, I haven't really noticed being any slower.
Have you felt like you're restless or fidgety lately?
Um... no, not really. I just... I sit there. I don't think I'm fidgeting or anything. Just... sitting.
Are there any activities that you still enjoy or find pleasure in?

No... not really. I just... I haven't touched my camera in weeks. And I haven't even checked the bird feeders, or... or looked at what's coming up in the garden. I used to care about that stuff. It used to be... how I felt like myself. But now... I just don't.
Have you had any thoughts of self-harm besides wondering what would happen if you didn't turn the wheel while driving?

Um... no. Not really self-harm, I don't think. Just... well, that's actually why I made the appointment. I just... I keep having this thought that it would be easier if I just went to sleep and didn't wake up. But... I wouldn't actually do anything.
Do you feel like your movements or reactions are slower than they should be?
Um... no. I don't... I don't think so. I just feel... heavy, I guess. But I don't think I'm moving slower. Just... tired.
Have you felt like you're doing things more slowly than you usually do?
I... I think you just asked me that. No, I don't think I'm doing things slower. Just... tired.
Have you felt like you're doing things more slowly than you usually do or have trouble getting started on activities?

Like I said... no, I'm not moving slower. And getting started on things... I don't know. I still go to work at the clinic. I just do what I need to do. It's not that I can't start, I'm just... really tired.
Have you had any difficulty concentrating or making decisions over the past month?
Um... no. I don't think so. I mean, I still do my job fine. I don't really have trouble with that.
Have you felt like you're fidgeting or unable to sit still when you're at work or at home?
No. I just sit there. I'm not... fidgeting.
Have you experienced a significant decrease in self-esteem over the past month?

I don't know if it's... self-esteem. I just... I guess I've been telling myself I'm a terrible person lately. There's been some disruption at home and I... I resent it, which I know I shouldn't. I just kind of replay every impatient look I give, or every sharp comment I make. It just... it makes me think my husband and the family would probably be better off without me.
Have you had any difficulty with your daily functioning at work or at home due to your current state?

I know I just said work was fine, but... I guess I have been making a few mistakes at the clinic lately. I just... I try to stay away from people. Even my friends. I don't want to snap at them, or... I don't know, just fall apart. 

And at home... my husband has basically had to take over everything. Paying the bills, making the meals. He... he kind of has to watch me, too. Just to keep me safe. When... when my thoughts get too dark.
Have you had any periods of more than two weeks where you felt better in the past month?
No. I haven't... I haven't felt better at all. It's just been... the same.
